content: “Xzar, Necc řaɣiɣ-dd x Baṣaliyil, mmis n Uri, mmis n Ḥur, zi teqbič n Yahuda s yisem nnes.
Ccureɣ t s Arruḥ n AREBBI, s tiɣit, s řeɛqeř, s tussna u s marra min ittxeṣṣan n tzemmar n ṣṣnayeɛ,
ḥima ad ixemmem ireqqamen s lfenn, maḥend ad ten tteggen s wureɣ d nnuqart d nnḥas,
u ḥima ad neqcen iẓra iɣřan maḥend ad ten ggen di tcuyar nsen, u ḥima ad neqcen akeccuḍ, ḥima ammu i ɣa ggen marra řxedmet.
Aqa Necc ggiɣ akides Ahuliyab, mmis n Axisamak, zi řaǧ n Dan. Deg wuř n marra inni ɣar iǧa wuř d amiɣis, ggiɣ tiɣit. Nitni ad ggen marra min xef weṣṣiɣ:
Aqiḍun n Umsagar, Ttabut n Cchadet, taqebbart n weṣřaḥ nni xas iǧan, u marra řeqcuɛ n Uqiḍun:
tazewḍa ak-d marra řeqcuɛ nnes, d řqendiř iṣfan s marra řeqcuɛ nnes d uɛalṭar n řebxur,
aɛalṭar n wecmaḍ ak-d marra řeqcuɛ nnes d tbanyut s uḍar nnes,
arruḍ n tsexxart d warruḍ iqeddsen n Harun, akehhan, d warruḍ n warraw nnes, maḥend ad sexxaren am ukehhan,
d zzect i wedhan, d řebxur ittfuḥen i Zzawect Iqeddsen. Ɛlaḥsab marra minzi cek umureɣ ad ggen marra aya.”
“Cek, siweř ak-d ayt n Israil, ini: ‘Ad teḥḍam ussan n ssebt inu, minzi ssebt d řeɛřamet jar ayi d kenniw, i marra jjiřat nwem, ḥima ad tessnem belli Necc d SIDI, wenni kenniw issqeddsen.
Ḥḍam ass n ssebt, minzi iqeddes i iǧa i kenniw! Wenni t ɣa issfesden, ad t nɣen nican, minzi man wen i dayes ɣa iggin ca n řxedmet, ad ittwaqḍeɛ zi řwesṭ n řgens nnes.
Setta n wussan ad tegged řxedmet uca deg wass wiss sebɛa ad yiři d ssebt, arraḥet tmun, tqeddes i teǧa i SIDI! Kuř ijj, wenni iggin ca n řxedmet deg wass n ssebt, ad t nɣen nican.
Ayt n Israil ad ḥḍan ass n ssebt, ad ḥḍan ssebt di marra jjiřat nsen am ijj n Řɛahd i řebda.
Ad tiři d ict n řeɛřamet jar ayi d ayt n Israil, minzi di setta n wussan igga SIDI ajenna d temmurt u deg wass wiss sebɛa yareyyeḥ, yarra nnefs.”
Řami ikemmeř SIDI awař i kides issiwřen x wedrar n Sina, iwca i Musa tnayen n teřwiḥin n Cchadet. Tuɣa tiřwiḥin nni zeg weẓru, ttwarint s uḍaḍ n AREBBI.
